key_points: Costco announced a 13% dividend hike, signaling strong cash flow generation and management confidence in earnings sustainability
Multiple institutional investors (CalSTRS, Formuepleje, Groupe la Francaise, HighTower, Trans Canada Capital, Ameritas) increased COST positions, indicating continued institutional accumulation
Amundi reduced its COST stake, but this is offset by net buying from other large holders
Most other headlines (market-wide commentary, unrelated companies, general macro) have no direct bearing on COST fundamentals

None of the headlines represent thesis-changing events (no earnings surprise, guidance revision, or material operational news); the dividend hike provides modest positive confirmation of the existing bull case
